pp-good-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (10) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (10) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (10) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

ppw-l0.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ppw-l0.query: WITH w AS ( SELECT i.innings_id, i.match_id, i.batting_team_id bt, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT w.wk, CASE WHEN w.bt IN (10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_t, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = w.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM w JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = w.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL

pp-steady.label: IPL win rate after 50–59 powerplay runs for no more than one wicket
pp-steady.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pp-steady.query: WITH pp AS (SELECT i.innings_id, i.match_id, i.batting_team_id bt, SUM(d.total_runs) r, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) w FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN r BETWEEN 50 AND 59 AND w <= 1 THEN 'steady' WHEN r >= 60 AND w >= 2 THEN 'reckless' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = pp.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM pp JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = pp.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY k HAVING k IS NOT NULL
